verdict.rationale: Alma's public pages reference some government-derived facts: the O-1A page lists a '4-6 months USCIS Processing Time' alongside its own timelines, and its International Entrepreneur Rule explainer cites the dated H.R. 1 parole fee change. However, neither item shows a source attribution or a link to the official USCIS or legislative source. Its headline approval-rate claims rest on internal case data, not government statistics. Missing for 10: linked citations to USCIS processing-time data or policy documents, FOIA-derived statistics, explicit sourcing methodology for public figures, and independent corroboration.
